q: The advice for potty training out there, I now realise, is one-size-fits-all - and kids are not that way. From the age of 3 to 4 i started and stopped all the methods. I tried EVERYTHING.
cx: Parent of a nappy-attached four-year-old shares what finally worked.

q: What finally worked? Doing what works with the temperament of my child specifically. He is stubborn and unwavering in his absolute need to keep nappies on.
In the end - letting him wear nappies was the magic solution. I told him if he pees or poops in them I have to take them away, and since then he treats them like underwear.
cx: Same parent on letting the child keep nappies on.
